relationships.subject: shear force
relationships.evidence_quote: Specifically, interleukin (IL)-6, neurogrowth factor (NGF), transforming growth factor (TGF)-alpha, platelet-derived growth factor (PDGF)-beta, and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) were increased.

key_findings: Two weeks of sustained shear force on rat intervertebral discs increased IL-6, NGF, TGF-alpha, PDGF-beta and VEGF in DRG tissue.
